USP Creation Framework
FICTIONAL TRAINING MATERIAL FOR TESTS

The USP formula
Use this formula for every offer: I help [who] get [outcome] in [timeframe] through [mechanism] without [pain].
Who must be a specific niche, not "business owners". Outcome must be measurable. Timeframe must be realistic.
The mechanism is the named method that makes the outcome possible. The pain is the thing they hate doing today.

Example of the USP formula
I help independent physiotherapy clinics get twenty new patient bookings a month in ninety days through a referral-first ad system without discounting their sessions.

Checking a USP
Read your USP out loud. If a stranger cannot repeat it back after one listen, it is too long.
If your outcome could be claimed by any competitor, sharpen the mechanism.
Never put a guarantee in the USP. Promise a direction, not a result.

Picking a niche
A good niche has three things: they can afford the offer, they can be reached with ads or DMs, and they already spend money to solve the problem.
Go narrow first. You can widen later once you have results.
